title: Acme Security Controls
body: Acme encrypts customer data in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Access to production requires phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication.

title: Acme Incident Response Addendum
body: Acme will notify affected customers within 72 hours after confirming a security incident. Incident exercises are conducted twice each year.

title: Acme Compliance Statement
body: The current SOC 2 Type II examination period ended June 30, 2026. The report is available to customers under NDA.
